notes.title: Soundtrack out now
notes.content:
Noir, gritty, immersive and serious: All of Interrogation’s art and sound is built around a feeling of tension. The almost-monochrome art and carefully hand-drawn rotoscoped animations play a vital role in creating this feeling. 

The game's heavy but smooth music inspired by classic noir movies, however, supports and amplifes this venture. It conveys the imminent danger that the player is working against as well as the serious nature of the challenge and brings the foreboding atmosphere to its fullest.

Interrogation's Original Soundtrack, composed by Dexi Antoniu, features 9 tracks. Each of them has been specially crafted to immerse the player in the mistery of a particular investigation while leaving enough room for them to think and focus. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474641/32a251eb72635008925852398f1d24927ab24c97.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Visual Novel Mode Update & flash sale!
notes.content:
Being a detective is hard work. You can't just spend all day at your computer. So we are bringing Interrogation to mobile! Grab it now on [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/interrogation-deceived/id1495159910]iOS[/url] and [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mixtvision.interrogation]Android[/url].
We are also introducing the [i]all new Visual Novel Mode[/i] on all platforms!

This new mode is a more relaxed way to experience the story of Interrogation. It lets you follow the thrilling plot by guiding you through the dialogue for the most part. You still get to make moral decisions, but there is no game over. The best of both worlds!

Last but not least we have a little something special: 
We know that a lot of us are spending more time at home these days, so we partnered with our friends at FAR: Lone Sails for a flash sale starting 10am PST to help pass the time. We just came out with our brand new Visual Novel mode & FAR dropped its price lower than ever before - stay safe and we hope you enjoy the games!

You can get FAR here:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/609320/FAR_Lone_Sails/

Be safe out there, detective!
[i]- Team Interrogation[/i]

notes.title: Game patch: Achievements available now!
notes.content:
Which mug would your team members gift you these holidays? “Best Boss” or “Bad Boss”? Find out with our newest update that includes, among other things, many achievements for you to unlock!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474641/1d2363684ae09a033d95fb3de258e0e99194afe5.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34474641/b167add880b905c0010082aa7b70a69d225924da.png[/img]

[b]Interrogation 1.0.1 patch notes:[/b]
[list][*]Added Steam and GOG Achievements.
[*]Additional balancing for episodes 7 and 8.
[*]Fixed an issue where resolution was sometimes set unnecessarily low. After the update, a short benchmark will run once to determine the correct resolution.
[*]Other minor fixes and corrections.
[/list]
